title: dupatya armeria
intro: Dupatya armeria, commonly known as Sea Holly, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dupatya armeria include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and its potential to stimulate the immune system, aiding in the fight against infections. The bioactive constituents of Dupatya armeria include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
